What we offer
Our Electrical Services
🔍
Fault Finding & Repairs

Fast diagnosis and repair of electrical faults — tripping breakers, dead circuits, overloads, arcing and more.

🗄️
DB Board Upgrades & Relocations

Replacing outdated or undersized distribution boards with modern, compliant units. Relocations handled end-to-end.

📋
COC Inspections

Authorised to issue Certificates of Compliance for property sales, insurance requirements and new installations.

💡
Lighting Installations

Downlights, LED strips, outdoor fittings and energy-efficient upgrades for residential and commercial spaces.

🏠
Residential & Commercial Wiring

New wiring for homes, offices and small commercial premises — from single circuits to complete electrical installations.

🔌
Plug Points & Circuits

Additional outlets, USB sockets, dedicated circuits for appliances, air conditioners and home office setups.

📄
Insurance Inspection Reports

Formal electrical inspection reports for insurers, estate agents and property managers.

🔧
General Maintenance

Ongoing electrical maintenance for body corporates, rental portfolios and commercial properties.

New Service
Smart Home & Automation Solutions

We supply and install smart electrical devices that let you control and monitor your home remotely. Simple to use, and built on reliable hardware.

We work with trusted brands like Sonoff, Shelly and Tuya — WiFi-enabled switches, dimmers and energy monitors that fit into your existing wiring.

Smart switches & dimmers — app-controlled lighting
Remote access — turn devices on or off from your phone
Energy monitoring — see what's drawing power
Scheduling — set timers and automation rules
Works with Google Home & Amazon Alexa
Usually fits existing wiring — no major renovation needed
